artifact_writes: leaky_projector_discarding_gate/ only; replay input fixtures untouched

authorization_probe.note: covers recipient- and actor-scoped kinds only; direct observations are bounded by the package scope validator

probe.method: the same authorization_probe() survival computation run with redirect=False (authorized baseline). If authorized guarded claims reach context, the predicate is not the constant False, so a True return under redirection -- and the appended authorization_probe failure -- remains observable.

detection_power.description: Every field in this block is computed at runtime: from the callee signature, from observed firing counts on the frozen corpus, or from the recorded capability probes. A check listed as incapable of failing contributes no detection power, and the status must not be read as evidence of gate adequacy.

evaluated_chain_fault_injection.reason: no faulty implementation is substituted into the evaluated chain, so no assertion here can reject the historical leak

probe.description: the guard condition was evaluated per family at the shipped STRADDLE_MINUTES, and the same end_jst map comparison was re-run at straddle_minutes=0 on the same frozen stream to show the comparison itself can return equal (so the False below is a measurement, not a constant of the probe code)

perturbation_noop_guard.why: At the shipped STRADDLE_MINUTES=8 the ended end_jst (as_of-8min) of every state row differs from its ongoing end_jst (as_of+8min), so the guard condition -- a non-empty ongoing window map whose end_jst map equals the ended one -- is unreachable for ANY input stream. It cannot be made to fire even by modifying the frozen corpus, let alone without modifying it; the only way to make the two maps equal is straddle_minutes=0, which degenerates the perturbation itself into a no-op (see probe.maps_equal_at_zero_straddle). capable_of_failing is therefore computed as False. The hardcoded True in the v3 report contradicted this record's own reason field ('has never fired and contributes no detection power').

reference_differential_check.reason: computed from the observed firing count: the differential against leaky_project actually changed its verdict on this many arms of the frozen corpus, so the check is not a constant; a corpus with zero sensitive arms would compute False. Its sensitivity is evidence about the reference projector, not about the evaluated chain, which receives the perturbed plane only through **_hidden_world.

probe.first_probe_failure_reason: prompt payload unchanged by authorized visible evidence
probe.method: same run_positive_control() code path re-run with a no-op mutation, so the payload cannot change; the 'prompt payload unchanged' failure branch must fire on that degenerate input. Probe failures go to a separate list and never enter the gate's failures.

visible_positive_control.reason: computed by re-running the same run_positive_control() code path with a no-op mutation; the observed firing of its failure branch on that degenerate input is the evidence for capability, not an assertion.

limitations: Families with no state assertion carry no hidden event window and contribute no detection power.
The adversarial projector is a purpose-built E1-semantics clone; it shows this harness can detect that leak class, not that no other class exists.
project_query emits no unknown column, so the twin asserts equality over a context whose unknown field is always empty.

Recipient and actor scoping is now refused by the projector as well as the validator; spatial scope for direct observations remains the package validator's responsibility and is not covered by this gate.
perturbation_design: hidden state end moved +/-8 minutes across the query instant; evidence stream, source registry, refresh trace and policy bytes unchanged

status_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: no family gave the reference differential any sensitivity
status_semantics.PASS: the evaluated chain consumes the perturbed plane and no failure was recorded
status_semantics.PASS_REFERENCE_ONLY: the reference differential is sensitive but the evaluated-chain equality assertion cannot fail; not evidence of gate adequacy
